english: As we invoke the aid of the Holy Trinity—the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit—the true God:
we begin to transcribe {OCR?} the Book of Chronography {OCR?},
composed by Mar Gregory the Maphrian,
the light of the East and the West,
who is Abu'l-Faraj, son of Aaron the physician, from the city of Melitene,
and is surnamed Barhebraeus.
First, the preface.
O God, help my weakness.
Blessed are You, O Lord, Master of every beginning and ending.
You are the first, and You are the last.
Toward You every journey is directed,
and to You all thanksgiving is due,
and to the Son, the Word, the power of Your wisdom,
and to the Holy Spirit, the life of Your being,
from eternity, now, and forever.
And because this rational creature was created to know truth, that it might glorify it, and goodness, that it might attain it,
and gains abundant knowledge of the former through theoretical reflections,
and profits in knowledge of the latter through accounts of practical deeds,
the remembrance, therefore, of deeds, good and evil, performed in every generation,
confers no small benefit upon all those who are eager to acquire goodness
and take care to shun evil,
urging them to emulate {OCR?} the virtues it enumerates,
and encouraging them to reject the shameful deeds it recounts.
